An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''sector fleet''' patrolled the [[Barsa sector/Legends|Barsa sector]]. The [[Sector fleet/Legends|fleet]] responded to an [[Strike against Ubertica|attack]] against the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ubertica]] perpetrated by [[Savax]] and other members of the so-called [[True Ubese]] sometime between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
